guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for ASE atoms properties including shape, type, and extensiveness from a list of atoms objects
guess_target_metadata: guess target metadata including shape, type, and extensiveness from atom lengths and target samples
target_per_atom: determine whether target samples are per-atom properties by checking if the first dimension matches atom count
target_extensive: guess whether a property is intensive or extensive by analyzing per-atom normalized standard deviation
target_constant_shape: check whether target samples have a constant shape regardless of varying atom sizes
